explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of all power, wisdom, and righteousness for the believer.
The term describing God's close and caring relationship with humanity through Jesus Christ.
The title of Jesus Christ as Lord over all life and creation.
In the context of Ephesians 6, this refers to the invisible, heavenly realm as opposed to the physical world.
The spiritual conflict between good and evil that Christians face every day.
The term for the spiritual resources God gives believers to stand against the enemy's attacks, including truth, righteousness, and faith.
God's infallible word which forms the foundation of Christian living and protection against lies.
The quality of living in accordance with God's will and standards, given through Jesus Christ.
Symbolizes readiness to spread the gospel of peace wherever one goes.
The concept of faith that can extinguish all of the enemy's flaming arrows of doubt and attack.
Faith in salvation that protects the mind from false thoughts and despair.
God's word, the Bible, used actively to combat lies and misinterpretation.
Experience with God through prayer at all times for strength and unity among believers.
In Ephesians 6, this refers to the Holy Spirit who gives power, guidance, and the ability to pray correctly.
